title: Bugs and Suggestions
body:
If you encounter any issue while using the app, or would like to share a suggestion, please feel free to send it to me through the Report option in Settings.

If the app is not responding, please use the RESET option in Settings to restore it.

title: Welcome
body:
Welcome to the latest official update. This release marks the final manual update — from now on, everything will be fully automatic.

Insha Allah.
